Automatic updates, release channel, and the Updates page → [`app`](../qa/sweeps/app.md); Window buttons rows and the F1 shortcuts reference → [`app`](../qa/sweeps/app.md); Input-method and dead-key composition in Settings fields → [`app`](../qa/sweeps/app.md); Restore open tabs under General → Startup and the tab session it controls → [`browser`](../qa/sweeps/browser.md); Focus return after closing dialogs other than Settings → [`app`](../qa/sweeps/app.md); Focus return after closing the search palettes → [`browser`](../qa/sweeps/browser.md); Video backend, autoplay, text wrap, render-by-default rows, and syntax highlighting inside the preview panel → [`preview`](../qa/sweeps/preview.md); Thumbnail workers, thumbnail rendering, and what Show thumbnails changes in the file views → [`browser`](../qa/sweeps/browser.md); Remember sort and icon size per folder, Default sort, Forget all folder settings, and `folder-views.toml` → [`browser`](../qa/sweeps/browser.md); Show sizes in Columns view as it acts on the Columns badge → [`browser`](../qa/sweeps/browser.md); Search time limit and Search entry limit as they act on global search, pane filters, and the Partial results hint → [`browser`](../qa/sweeps/browser.md)
